summary.key_theme: Amazon 積極投資 AI 基礎設施與雲端運算，儘管面臨法律訴訟與物流營運挑戰，但市場對其長期成長潛力與 AI 變現能力持樂觀態度。

bullish.title: Amazon’s AI Bet is Already Starting to Pay Off
bullish.reason: AWS 雲端業務成長創下 18 季以來新高，顯示 AI 投資已開始轉化為實質營收，對股價具備強勁支撐。

bullish.title: Amazon obtains right to buy stock in Generac, boosting power company's share price by over 40%
bullish.reason: 透過與 Generac 簽署備用電力供應協議並取得認股權，展現 Amazon 為 AI 資料中心確保能源供應的策略前瞻性。

bullish.title: Prediction: Anthropic's IPO Will Be a Big Winner for Alphabet and Amazon Investors
bullish.reason: Anthropic 的 IPO 預期將為 Amazon 的投資組合帶來顯著資本利得，並強化其在 AI 生態系的影響力。

bullish.title: Billionaire David Tepper Has 40% of His Fund in Just 3 AI Stocks. Are They Still Buys?
bullish.reason: 知名對沖基金經理人 David Tepper 將 Amazon 列為前三大持股，顯示機構投資人對其 AI 轉型策略的信心。

bullish.title: Amazon (AMZN) Taps the UK Bond Market for the First Time to Help Fund its AI Buildout
bullish.reason: 成功發行 42.5 億英鎊債券，顯示公司融資能力強大，資金將專注於 AI 基礎設施建設。

bearish.title: Amazon (AMZN) Sued Again, This Time over How it Treats Pregnant Warehouse Workers
bearish.reason: 面臨全國性集體訴訟，可能引發勞工權益爭議並增加法律合規成本，對公司聲譽造成負面影響。

bearish.title: Investigators Dig into Landing Speed and Runway Safety After Amazon (AMZN)’s Fatal Miami Crash
bearish.reason: 涉及致命空難的調查可能導致物流營運受阻，並面臨聯邦監管機構更嚴格的飛安審查。

bearish.title: Amazon cargo delivery company files for Chapter 11 bankruptcy
bearish.reason: 合作的貨運公司破產可能導致物流配送中斷，雖影響有限，但凸顯供應鏈管理壓力。

neutral.title: Streaming’s Biggest Rivals Just Became Allies in Washington
neutral.reason: 與 Netflix 和 Google 在華盛頓進行政策遊說合作，屬於產業常態，對股價無直接影響。

neutral.title: Amazon says AI needs ‘strong safeguards’ in place before being released
neutral.reason: 呼籲 AI 安全監管是科技巨頭的標準立場，旨在降低監管風險，對營運影響中性。
